questions.question: How does Kasia describe her ADHD to the psychologist?
answers: I have a radio in my head — every station at once
questions.explanation: She says: "I have a radio in my head... Every station plays at once."

questions.question: What helps Kasia focus in class?
answers: A sensory fidget and the chance for short movement
questions.explanation: She gets a fidget; she may stand up briefly without disturbing anyone.

questions.question: What does Mum do before bedtime?
questions.explanation: No screens before bed; reading books.

questions.question: What does Kasia tell the class about ADHD?
answers: My brain works differently, not worse
I should sit in the corner
I'll never be good at school
questions.explanation: "No. It means my brain works differently. Not worse."

questions.question: What does Kasia want to become at university?
answers: A psychologist — to help children like her
questions.explanation: She studies psychology to support children with similar difficulties.
